title: Smells Like Teen Spirit: both hands, and the chords of G

blocks.text:
Now the two parts together: a chord held under each bar while the riff moves above it. Then the three main chords of G major.

**By the end** you can play bars 3–9 with both hands, and play G, C and D7 and change between them in time.

# Together
The left hand changes chord only on beat 1 of each bar and then holds. Put it down with the bar's first right-hand note, and let the right hand play on while it holds.

blocks.title: Bars 3–9 in time
blocks.doneWhen: 80% of the notes on time in one run

blocks.text:
# The chords of G major
In G major the three main chords are **G** (G B D), **C** (here G C E: the same C, its notes rearranged so the hand barely moves) and **D7** (F♯ C D: the D chord with a C added, which pulls back to G). Learn them by name, then change between them in time, with the C-major chords from earlier mixed in.

# If this happens
- **The left hand lets go too early.** Hold each chord for the whole bar.
- **The tied notes trip you up with both hands.** Slow down; Wait for me waits.

**Until the next lesson:** the seven bars once a day.
